responseAccountingCorrection.reason: CDP records local data/blob responses. Nine Web Awesome SVG data: fetches total4683bytes already included in the JS payload. The previous all-scheme aggregate double counted them as network transfer.

interpretationNotes: Cold En Reve vs Web Awesome LCP has overlapping exploratory paired intervals: desktop difference0ms CI[-6,4]; mobile10ms CI[-4,54.05]. Do not claim a firm cold-load winner.

Warm LCP difference is clearer in this cohort: En Reve minus Web Awesome mobile52ms CI[36,68], desktop8ms CI[8,12]. This is not source-level causality and richer date/other native capabilities remain confounders.
Scripted INP differs by one8ms quantization step: mobile8ms CI[0,8], desktop8ms CI[-4,8]. Avoid claiming a robust universal responsiveness winner.

All nine memory API checkpoints succeeded, but there is still only one session per implementation. Fluent WC browser DOM/listener growth is diagnostic, not proof of a leak; connected nodes and browser retention counters are distinct.

Lighthouse JSON retains unused simulation defaults rttMs150/throughputKbps1638.4 alongside the active DevTools requestLatencyMs100/download8000/upload2000 settings. Use the throttlingMethod and active fields; do not describe this as simulated Lantern throttling.

The acquisition interruption preceded creation of memory-v1. Completed255samples retain their hashes, and the new memory-v2 plus remaining51samples constitute the completed queue. No selected slow sample was replaced.

BFCache restoration is separate from successful diagnostic acquisition: En Reve3/5, Fluent WC4/5, Web Awesome5/5 restored, while all15returned pages remained interactive. Non-restoration reasons are masked; no mechanism or field-rate claim is supported.
